newsitem.title: ITALY: Gemina shares firmer in high volume.
newsitem.headline: Gemina shares firmer in high volume.

text.p: Shares in Italian financial holding Gemina rose in high volumes in early trading after Friday's company announcement that the sprawling group was to hive off its industrial interests into a new company.
Dealers said that the move to divide its industrial and financial interests was a logical one, and the shares were simply moving higher in response to this.
At 0855 GMT, Gemina shares were up 1.82 percent at 774 lire in a slightly firmer Milan market, after the stock was suspended on Friday pending a company announcement on its reorganisation.
